استعجلنا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْجَلْنَا (istaʕjalnā) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# اُسْتُعْجِلْنَا (ustuʕjilnā) /us.tuʕ.d͡ʒil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
